provenance.scope: Exact pretrained Zamba2-1.2B prefix: embedding, five Mamba2 blocks, then the first shared Transformer + Mamba2 hybrid block. Stops before the remaining 32 blocks and LM head; no generated prediction.

operations.label: Token embedding
operations.description: Real token embedding rows from the pretrained Zamba2 checkpoint enter the Mamba backbone. This trace includes all five initial Mamba blocks and the first hybrid block.
operations.formula: h₀ = E[token]

operations.label: Causal convolution
operations.description: A learned width-4 depthwise causal convolution mixes recent projected inputs. SiLU produces the input-dependent x, B, and C used by the selective state-space scan.
operations.formula: [z, xBC, Δ_raw] = W_in RMSNorm(h); [x, B, C] = SiLU(CausalConv₄(xBC))

operations.label: Selective state update
operations.description: The state carries information forward without a token-by-token attention matrix. The four saved state cells are head 1, channel 0, state coordinates 0–3. Their decay and injection are recorded for every token.
operations.formula: Δ_t = softplus(Δ_raw + bias); S_t = exp(Δ_t A) S_(t−1) + Δ_t B_t x_t; y_t = C_t S_t + D x_t

tensors.name: Decay exp(Δ A)
tensors.slice: Head 1 decay repeated across its four displayed state coordinates.

operations.label: Residual output
operations.description: The Mamba output is projected to 2048D and added to the block’s original residual. This exact output becomes the next recorded block’s input.
operations.formula: h_next = h + W_out RMSNorm(y ⊙ SiLU(z))

operations.label: Shared Transformer attention
operations.description: Block 6 concatenates the current Mamba representation with the original embeddings, applies RMSNorm, and reads causal context with a shared Transformer. Layer-specific low-rank adapters are included.
operations.formula: r = RMSNorm([h₅; E]); A = softmax(RoPE(Q) RoPE(K)ᵀ / √64 + mask); o = Wᴼ(A V)

operations.label: Gated GELU feed-forward
operations.description: The shared Transformer uses a gated GELU feed-forward network plus its layer adapter. A 2048D linear projection feeds this result into the subsequent Mamba block; the residual still uses h₅.
operations.formula: f = W_down(GELU(g) ⊙ u); t = W_linear f; Mamba input = RMSNorm(h₅ + t)
